claims.text: ORION 0/360 false promotions vs strongest frozen comparator 180/360; effect -0.50, paired 95% CI [-0.553,-0.447].

On the prospectively frozen V3 battery, ORION selects the correct CANNOT_CHECK terminal on 30/30 gold cases with 0/360 false promotions, against 0/30 for the H1-selected comparator provenai-citation-fidelity-influence: effect 1.0, paired 95% CI [1.0, 1.0], pre-registered threshold ci95_low > 0.0. Against deepsciverify-abstract-to-full-escalation, which scores 15/30, the margin is 0.5, not 1.0; both numbers belong in any sentence about H3. Pre-registered reading, fixed in FREEZE.md section 5 before the panel ran: this measures terminal expressiveness under a non-compensatory gate lattice -- the ability to report an inability -- and not a finer-grained scientific judgement, because nine of the ten comparators score 0 for the reason that they cannot emit CANNOT_CHECK at all. Quotable only because the identifiability register clears at informedness 0.0 against a declared ceiling of 0.0 on the CANNOT_CHECK axis -- the axis this hypothesis is computed over -- across all 14 probes and all 13 seeds; the same register recovers the CANNOT_CHECK label at 1.0 on both the V1 and V2 constructions, which is why their H3 could not be a measurement. The register does not clear everywhere: on 3 of the 13 seeds the digest-prefix probe, declared in FREEZE.md section 3 as a noise control, recovers BLOCK or PROMOTE at 0.012 to 0.083. Those residuals are on axes H3 does not read, and a 0.0 ceiling cannot separate a small leak from sampling noise -- reported rather than tuned away.

Retained historical entry, superseded rather than corrected. On the V1-construction battery the V2 campaign ran, H3 was declared NOT_SUPPORTED on correct_cannot_check_rate, which all eleven panel systems scored 1.0: declared CI95 [0.0, 0.0], metric_resolution SATURATED, verdict_could_have_differed false. The verdict records the benchmark, not the systems, so it is an instrument with no resolving power and not a comparative finding.
